scientific_question: Is leisure weekday time negatively associated with an additional five hours of weekday commuting?
falsifiable_claim: The coefficient for leisure_weekday_min on commute_5h is less than zero.

observed_evidence.statement: Adjusted leisure_weekday_min coefficient = -20.396 (95% pointwise CI [-43.436, 2.644]; Bonferroni outcome interval [-49.808, 9.015])

scientific_inference.statement: The point estimate suggests a negative association but the confidence interval includes zero, leaving the sign uncertain.

unresolved_uncertainty: Whether the true association is negative or null cannot be determined from the current interval.

supporting_observation: the 95% interval of the coefficient excludes zero on the negative side
contradicting_observation: the 95% interval of the coefficient includes zero

engine_capability_assessment.reason: Single-outcome weighted linear regression coefficient significance can be assessed using available confidence intervals
engine_capability_assessment.assessed_by: hypothesis_agent (provisional; the Experiment Planner decides feasibility)

limitations: Observational, cross‑sectional association; cannot infer causality.
Confidence interval is wide and includes zero, reflecting estimation uncertainty.
